name: chatmate
description: Read the Telegram chats connected to your personal ChatMate bot, get answers in that bot and confirm steps there before they happen.

interface.shortDescription: Your Telegram chats in the conversation
interface.longDescription: Connect the Telegram chats of your personal ChatMate bot. Ask what people wrote, find a message or a person, get a reply or an approval request in the bot. New chats you connect in Telegram appear automatically.
defaultPrompt: What did people write to me on Telegram today?
Find the message where we agreed on the price.
